description: Administrator only. Both confirm and confirmExclusive must be true: all other instances/external writers must be stopped and the target must be empty and dedicated. Restarts the backend in maintenance, backs up and verifies copied data before activation. Supports SQLite to/from MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL; direct server-to-server migration is rejected. Switching back is a new migration, never reopening an archival SQLite file.

400.description: Invalid request, incompatible data, or unusable target; no credentials are returned

403.description: Required permission, operation capability, or CSRF validation failed

409.description: An operation is already active or cannot be acknowledged in this phase

503.description: Database setup or maintenance prevents this action
